Problem Statement:
Vishal is a person who loves to find interesting applications of matrices. He decides he will store his password in a square matrix. The password can be recovered only if the matrix is traversed in a particular way. He leaves a clue to can crack his password which is "To find it , make your head spin like a spiral, clockwise! ". Find out what was Vishal's password, given a square matrix.
input_spec: Dimensions of the square matrix followed by elements of the matrix.
output_spec: A specific sequence involving all the elements in the matrix.
